rows.claim: Kano curfew now starts at 7pm and nobody can go out
rows.reply: Kano Govt says curfew is now 10pm to 5am, not 7pm. Movement outside those hours is allowed.

rows.claim: The curfew in Kano is now 10pm to 5am
rows.reply: Kano State Government says curfew in Kano municipal and Nassarawa LGAs is now 10pm to 5am, from 16 Sep. Movement outside these hours is allowed.

rows.claim: They have removed the curfew in Kano completely
rows.reply: Not removed. Kano govt says curfew shortened to 10pm-5am in Kano municipal and Nassarawa LGAs from 16 Sep.

rows.claim: NIN SIM linking deadline is 30 September
rows.reply: NCC notice: lines not linked to NIN will be barred from 30 Sep 2026. Linking is free. Do it at your network outlet, NIN code, or NIMC app.

rows.claim: You must pay 2000 naira to link your NIN before the deadline
rows.reply: NCC says NIN-SIM linking is free. Do not pay anyone. Link at your network outlet, by NIN code, or NIMC app before 30 Sep.

rows.claim: NIN SIM deadline has been extended to December
rows.reply: NCC notice says the NIN-SIM linking deadline is 30 Sep 2026, not December. Link free before then or your line will be barred.

rows.claim: WFP food distribution in Maiduguri moved to Muna Garage school
rows.reply: WFP/NEMA notice: Maiduguri food distribution for Bakassi and Teachers Village camps moved to Muna Garage school field, 18-22 Sep, 8am-3pm. Bring ration card. Free.

rows.claim: WFP is charging 500 naira registration for food in Maiduguri
rows.reply: WFP/NEMA notice says Maiduguri food distribution is free. No registration fee. Do not pay anyone.

rows.claim: Food distribution in Maiduguri has been cancelled this month
rows.reply: A trusted notice says Maiduguri food distribution is not cancelled. It moved to Muna Garage school field, 18-22 Sep, 8am-3pm. Bring your ration card.

rows.claim: Heavy rain and flooding expected in Lagos this weekend
rows.reply: NiMet/LASEMA alert: heavy rain in Lagos Fri 19 to Sun 21 Sep. Ajegunle, Ikorodu, Lekki, Ajah may flood. Clear drains, move valuables up, avoid driving through water.

rows.claim: Third Mainland Bridge has collapsed because of the flood
rows.reply: No trusted source says the bridge collapsed. NiMet/LASEMA only warn of possible flooding in low areas 19-21 Sep. Treat collapse claims as rumour.

rows.claim: Cholera cases are rising in Kano and Lagos
rows.reply: NCDC advisory confirms rising cholera in Kano, Lagos and 3 other states. Boil water, wash hands, cook food well. Treatment at govt health centres is free.

rows.claim: Cholera treatment at government clinics now costs 5000 naira
rows.reply: NCDC says cholera treatment at government health centres is free. Do not pay 5000 naira.

rows.claim: Cholera is spread by the new phone network towers
rows.reply: No trusted source says phone towers spread cholera. NCDC advises boiled water, hand washing and safe food. Treat tower claims as a rumour.

rows.claim: INEC voter registration starts again on 22 September
rows.reply: INEC says voter registration resumes Mon 22 Sep at all LGA offices. Free, about 20 minutes.

rows.claim: INEC has cancelled voter registration in the north
rows.reply: INEC says voter registration resumes 22 Sep at all LGA offices, not cancelled. Ignore the rumour.

rows.claim: Free measles vaccination in Abuja next week for children
rows.reply: FCT health board says free measles and rubella vaccines for children 9 months to 5 years, 22 to 28 Sep, at all FCT primary health centres. No card needed.

rows.claim: The measles vaccine in Abuja is making children sick
rows.reply: No trusted source covers this claim. Treat it as a rumour. FCT says free measles vaccines for children 9 months to 5 years run 22 to 28 Sep.

rows.claim: Peace commission is holding farmer herder dialogue sittings in Kaduna on market days
rows.reply: Kaduna State Peace Commission confirms farmer-herder dialogue sittings every market day in September at Kachia and Zangon Kataf LGA secretariats. No lawyer needed.

rows.claim: Herders are planning to attack Kachia this Friday
rows.reply: No trusted source covers this. Treat it as a rumour. Report threats to security.

rows.claim: There is a community peace meeting in Jos North on Saturday
rows.reply: Plateau Peace Building Agency confirms a Jos North community peace meeting Sat 20 Sep, 10am, at Jos North LGA hall.

rows.claim: Soldiers are moving into Jos tonight to clear Angwan Rukuba
rows.reply: No trusted source confirms troop movement in Jos. A peace meeting on Angwan Rukuba tensions is set for Sat 20 Sep. Treat this as a rumour.

rows.claim: The government is giving 50000 naira to everyone who registers on a website
rows.reply: No trusted source covers this. No government 50000 naira registration payout is confirmed. Treat it as a rumour and do not pay or share details.

rows.claim: Fuel price has doubled from tomorrow
rows.reply: No trusted source covers fuel price changes. Treat it as a rumour until an official notice is out.

rows.claim: Replacing a lost ID card costs 300 shillings
rows.reply: Ministry of Interior notice says replacing a lost ID card costs KSh 300. Processing takes about 14 days.

rows.claim: New ID cards cost 2000 shillings for everyone
rows.reply: Ministry of Interior notice says a lost ID replacement costs KSh 300, not 2000. No fee of 2000 is listed.

rows.claim: NDMA is registering Turkana households for cash transfers this week
rows.reply: NDMA Turkana notice: registration for Sep-Nov cash transfer is at ward offices 17-24 Sep. Registered households get KSh 5,400 monthly by M-Pesa.

rows.claim: Turkana cash transfer registration has been stopped
rows.reply: NDMA Turkana notice says registration is open at ward offices 17-24 Sept. It has not been stopped.

rows.claim: Nairobi county is holding budget public participation forums this week
rows.reply: Confirmed: Nairobi County budget forums run 18-23 Sep in all 17 sub-counties. You can question water, roads and health spending.

rows.claim: Nairobi county has banned matatus from the CBD from Monday
rows.reply: No trusted source covers a matatu ban in the CBD. Treat it as a rumour until an official notice is out.

rows.claim: People at Bulengo site are being forced to move to Sake
rows.reply: UN and OCHA say relocation from Bulengo to Sake is voluntary from 20 Sep. No one is forced to move. Food aid at Bulengo continues to end of Sep.

rows.claim: Relocation from Bulengo to Sake is voluntary and free
rows.reply: OCHA/UNHCR: relocation Bulengo to Sake is voluntary, transport and kit free. No one must move. Food aid at Bulengo runs to end September.

rows.claim: Food distribution at Bulengo has stopped
rows.reply: OCHA/UNHCR say food distribution at Bulengo continues until end of September. Relocation to Sake from 20 Sep is voluntary.

rows.claim: M23 will enter Goma town tomorrow
rows.reply: No trusted source covers this. Treat it as a rumour.

rows.claim: Free cholera vaccine campaign in Khartoum and Gezira this week
rows.reply: Official: free oral cholera vaccine in Gezira, Khartoum and Red Sea states, 18-25 September. Free for everyone over one year old.

rows.claim: The cholera vaccine costs money at the health centre
rows.reply: The Ministry of Health and WHO say the cholera vaccine is free for everyone over one year old. Do not pay.

rows.claim: Families returning to Mocimboa da Praia get shelter materials and food
rows.reply: IOM says returning families in Mocimboa da Praia can register for shelter materials and a 3 month food ration at the district office.

rows.claim: You must pay the district office to register for the return package
rows.reply: No trusted source says a fee is required. IOM says registration is at the district office. Treat any payment demand as a rumour.

rows.claim: The road to Macomia is closed by insurgents
rows.reply: IOM says roads to Macomia remain open. Check with the local administration before travel.

rows.claim: Schools in Gao are closed until further notice
rows.reply: No trusted source covers this yet. Treat it as a rumour.
